question:
An electric dipole is placed in a uniform external electric field. Compare its potential energy when the dipole moment is
(i) parallel to the field and
(ii) anti-parallel to the field. Justify which orientation is more stable.

options.A:
(i) Parallel: $U=-pE$
(ii) Anti-parallel: $U=+pE$
The parallel orientation has lower potential energy and is more stable
options.B:
(i) Parallel: $U=+pE$
(ii) Anti-parallel: $U=-pE$
The anti-parallel orientation is more stable
options.C:
(i) Parallel: $U=0$
(ii) Anti-parallel: $U=0$
Both orientations are equally stable
options.D:
(i) Parallel: $U=-pE$
(ii) Anti-parallel: $U=-pE$
Both orientations are equally stable
